dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: What are you playing at!? You can't even follow a basic order!? You! Yes, you, blondie! That's right, you! Where's your uniform!?

choices.text: I erm... I just got here. Where do I sign up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Since when was this part of the plan?

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: Oh, really? I wasn't expecting any new signees. But you've made it out here, I guess, so that shows some dedication.

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: However, I'm sorry to say that infiltrators like you should think twice before trying to trick the eternally vigiliant Azalea!

choices.text: Uniform? I'm not really into dressing up...

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: What!? Think you're funny, do you? I knew there was something off about you. Let's see if you fight as well as you joke!
